name: loam
description: Loam. The memory substrate for personal AI. Search your AI history on your own Cloudflare. BYOK sovereignty. The soil layer beneath whatever you build on top.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p ingest && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json && node scripts/verify-typecheck-coverage.mjs
scripts.test:scripts: node --test scripts/verify-action-pins.test.mjs && node --test scripts/verify-coverage-scope.test.mjs && node --test scripts/ts-inventory.test.mjs && node --test scripts/verify-typecheck-coverage.test.mjs && node --test scripts/dco-check.test.mjs && node --test scripts/lib/main-module.test.mjs
scripts.build: mkdir -p .tmp-build && cp wrangler.jsonc.template .tmp-build/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy src/index.ts --dry-run --outdir dist --config .tmp-build/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.validate: npm run verify:action-pins && npm run test:scripts && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.coverage: node scripts/verify-coverage-scope.mjs --prepare && vitest run --coverage && node scripts/verify-coverage-scope.mjs
scripts.local:gate: npm run validate && npm run local:dco && npm run coverage
